messages:
maya: Quick post-deploy triage for onboarding_v2 launch. We got a mix of bug reports and feature asks. Goal: pick what we fix in the next 10 working days. Outline: immediate hotfixes (P0), customer-impacting regressions (P1), then small feature polish.

sean: Saw the spike in 500s from the routing service after the rollout. Error rate peaked at 3.8% between 09:12-09:45 PT. Logs show N+1 timeouts on downstream quota checks.

priya: CS flagged 2 paying customers who saw session resets during onboarding. They asked for an ETA to be confident about renewals. Marking those as P1 customer-impact.

rob: Root cause looks like a previously unseen race in the cache warmup. Patch available but it touches session serialization code. Estimate: patch + test = 1.5d, test matrix for edge cases = 0.5d.

callie: From sales: one enterprise is asking for SLA confirmation before contract signature. If we can guarantee a 99.9% window for their flows or offer a temporary dedicated routing, that might close the deal.

maya: Proposal for iteration scope:
- P0: any crash/outage/hot-path regression -> immediate rollback/hotfix
- P1 (paying customers / revenue risk / >=2% error spike) -> target this iteration
- P1 that requires risky infra changes -> ship a temporary FF gate + schedule full fix next cycle
- All other enhancements -> grooming list for next minor

sean: Suggest we prefer feature-flagged rollouts for risky fixes. Example approach: ship cache-fix behind ff onboarding_v2_cache_hotfix, enable for affected customers only, monitor for 24h, then global.

rob: I can implement flag and scoped enable. Ops note: we need a short README in the runbook describing how to disable the flag quickly: `curl -XPOST https://ffsvc/flags/onboarding_v2_cache_hotfix -d '{"enabled":false}'` and the playbook step: rollback-order -> disable-ff -> restart-workers.

priya: I'll draft the customer-facing note saying weare addressing intermittent resets and may toggle a stability gate. Keep language: "temporary improvement to restore stable sessions". CC: comms.

maya: Action items (add estimates + labels today):
- LOG-1892 cache race patch (prio:P1, effort:med) -> rob 1.5d
- CRM-402 onboarding session incidents (prio:P1, effort:quick) -> priya to draft customer note
- SALES-98 SLA ask (prio:P1, effort:med) -> callie to propose dedicated routing interim
- GROOM-flaglist collect minor polish items (triage:postdeploy, effort:quick)

sean: I'll open a quick monitor dashboard: `perf -> onboarding_v2 / error_rate / customer_tag` and add an alert: error_rate > 1.5% for 10m.

ops-bot: Monitor rule created: onboarding_v2_error_rate_alert. Trigger: >1.5% for 10m. Notification: #eng-oncall and #product.

callie: For the SLA ask, can we offer a templated note: dedicated routing for 30 days while we stabilize? If so sales can push that to the prospect.

rob: Technically feasible. Provisioning time ~2d if infra config is ready; can be automated. I'll estimate 2d and flag any blockers.

maya: One small governance ask: freeze new feature merges to main until we clear the oncall window (48h) unless runway-approved by eng leads. Use branch protection rule as needed.

sean: Will add a temporary branch protection/merge gate: label `postdeploy-stability` required.

priya: Scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize ticket owners and customer comm copy. I'll send the invite.

maya: Thanks everyone. Recap: label tickets, implement ff for cache fix if needed, ops runbook snippet added, sales/cs coordinate on SLA/customer notes, 48h freeze on new merges. We'll reconvene after 24h monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
